data.name: ExampleReadme
data.value:
Example server save: Example-All-Options ========================================
This save shows every server save option filled in once with sensible values. Trebuchet creates it once automatically. To build your own: duplicate it under Server Saves and replace the placeholders. If you delete it, Trebuchet does not create it again.
CHANGE BEFORE THE FIRST START - Admin, server and RCon password (they are set to example values). - Discord webhooks: enter real URLs, in the profile (Discord) and in the action of the starting sequence. Placeholders are ignored or logged as invalid, the server still starts. - Sudo super admins: your Steam ID instead of 76561190000000000. - MULTIHOME is off; 192.168.1.10 is only an example (network configuration > Use for MULTIHOME).
HOW IT WORKS TOGETHER - Restarts: daily at 06:00 and 18:00 (max. 2 per day, at least 2 h uptime), plus mod/server updates and RequiresRestart.txt in the profile or instance folder. - Warnings: 15/5/3/1 minutes before, over RCon (broadcast) and Discord. If nobody is online the server restarts right away. Shortly before the restart the restart message is sent. IMPORTANT: RCon must be on, otherwise no player gets the warnings. A custom stopping sequence would replace the warnings, so it is empty here. - Starting sequence: start the server (main action), wait until online, then 'Message to players' (RCon only, greeting in game) and 'Discord webhook' (formatted announcement, e.g. for a public channel). Replace the webhook URL of the action. The profile webhooks (Discord) get the ready, crash and restart messages separately. - Ready and shutdown messages go to Discord. - Message method broadcast works with every chat mod (popup). totpop shows the popup of Tot ! Chat. - Crash: crashed servers are restarted (max. 3 times in 15 min, then a pause and a Discord message). A server that hangs for more than 300 s is stopped (Kill Crashed Servers). - Backup on every shutdown to %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Conan-Backups\Example-All-Options, 14 daily folders are kept. Afterwards example-after-backup.bat runs (writes script-log.txt). - Voice chat completely off (serverVoiceChat=0 + engine voice off). - Log filters: default list incl. LogOnlineSubsystemFls=Fatal (stops the voice error flood). - Performance: priority 'Above normal', enforced on every refresh. - Additional launch argument -nosound (example for your own arguments).
Note: the notification templates for all servers (crash, online, reasons ...) are at the very bottom of Server Saves and apply to every profile.

data.value: Sends a test message with the selected message method to every running server that uses this save and shows the RCon answer. Check in game whether it arrives. RCon must have been on when the server started.

data.name: DefaultNotificationModUpdateDetected
data.value: Mod updates found: {modList}. The server restarts to install them.

data.name: ServerStopDelayText
data.value: When should instance {0} stop? With a delay, the players are warned with the message method of the save: when the countdown starts and at the warning times of the save that fit into the delay. If nobody is online (and "Restart immediately when nobody is online" is on), it stops right away.

data.name: ServerRestartDelayText
data.value: When should instance {0} restart? With a delay, the players are warned with the message method of the save: when the countdown starts and with the restart warnings of the save that fit into the delay. "Now" restarts without warnings.

data.name: DefaultNotificationCountdownCancelled
data.value: The announced restart or shutdown of {servername} is cancelled.

data.name: PauseRestartsTip
data.value: Cancels a running restart or stop countdown and pauses the automatic restarts (schedule, server and mod updates, RequiresRestart.txt), e.g. during an RP event.

data.name: PauseRestartsText
data.value: How long should the automatic restarts of instance {0} pause (schedule, server and mod updates, RequiresRestart.txt)? Manual stops and restarts still work, outdated mods are updated with the first restart after the pause.

data.name: CancelCountdownText
data.value: The countdown of instance {0} is cancelled and the players are told. How long should the automatic restarts pause afterwards (schedule, server and mod updates, RequiresRestart.txt)? "Only cancel" pauses nothing: a pending update or scheduled restart starts its countdown again right away. Outdated mods are updated with the first restart after the pause.
